name: Goldcap Cider
description: A flask of Goldcap cider from Vaelmere and Thornveil orchards — one of the Feywood's canonical trade exports, familiar enough to reach realm taverns via Vaelmere's flow.
narrative_effects: Standard alcoholic drink; its specific tartness is recognized by regular realm drinkers of Feywood exports.
Consistent quality across vintages owing to the Goldcap apple's reliable character.
